name: Lending, Credit & Investment
summary: Lending and investment businesses handle other people's money and personal data, so licensing, documentation and consumer rules must be right from the start.
needs: Assess which licences and registrations apply to the lending or investment activity, including FCCPC digital lending requirements where relevant
Prepare loan agreements, customer terms, investment agreements and debt recovery documentation
Keep corporate governance, statutory filings and tax compliance up to date
Protect borrower and investor personal data with documented policies
